name: production-agentic-rag-course
one_liner: A hands-on course that teaches you, step by step, how to build a real research-assistant AI that searches and answers questions over documents.
buyer: An aspiring AI engineer who wants to move from tutorials to a genuinely production-grade AI project for their portfolio or job search.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp licenses the curriculum as part of a paid AI-engineering certificate program.
A corporate L&D team buys it as structured internal training for engineers moving into AI roles.
The creator runs it as a paid cohort course with live mentorship and project reviews.

money_ideas.idea: Sell cohort-based paid course seats with live mentorship and code review.
License the curriculum to bootcamps or corporate training teams.
Offer an ongoing 'office hours' community subscription for alumni.

steal_this: This weekend, package the existing material into a $199 self-paced cohort with a weekly live Q&A call and launch it to a waitlist.
